_README: Social feed data for the homepage. This is the ONLY file to edit to refresh the feed.
Every entry must carry a real Instagram permalink — never the profile URL.
No engagement numbers: we cannot verify likes or comments, so we do not display them.
When the Instagram Graph API is wired up, a scheduled job overwrites `posts` here
and the markup does not change.
